newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybeans steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybeans steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis values were steady on Tuesday in subdued dealings.
Dealers cited limited farm movement.

Problems on the uppper Mississippi continue to hamper transportation. Railroad operations in the Dakotas and Minnesota were impeded Tuesday by high water with some rail lines south of Minneapolis-St. Paul possibly being closed later this week, railroad officials said.
"You are a fool if you trade on speculation on when the Mississippi will be open again," one dealer said, referring to business being somewhat at a standstill.

High water also prompted the U.S. Army Corp of Engineers to close two more locks on the upper Mississippi, a spokeswoman said. The additional closures mean the river is shut to navigation from Upper and Lower St. Anthony's Falls north of Minneapolis, Minn., to Alma, Wisc.
